## Relationships

### [Geraldine](../character/geraldine.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bertram--geraldine.md)

Bertram is a character within a fictional story written by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), in which he is romantically involved with [Geraldine](../character/geraldine.md) and bound to her by a storybook engagement. Within the plot of this narrative, Bertram rescues [Geraldine](../character/geraldine.md) from danger. Their connection exists purely as a romantic trope within the imaginative tales crafted by the local children's story club.

- Romantically involved with — fictional story engagement  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Saved  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)</sub>
